Bot.rationale: Bot traffic may involve command/control or tool transfer; mapping requires more incident context.

DDoS.rationale: Distributed denial-of-service traffic aligns with network denial-of-service impact.

DoS GoldenEye.rationale: GoldenEye is represented as a DoS scenario; mapped conservatively to endpoint denial of service.

DoS Hulk.rationale: CICIDS DoS Hulk is a denial-of-service scenario; exact ATT&CK sub-technique depends on target/service context.

DoS Slowhttptest.rationale: Slow HTTP DoS behavior maps to service/resource exhaustion under endpoint denial of service.

DoS slowloris.rationale: Slowloris is a DoS scenario; mapped conservatively to endpoint denial of service.

FTP-Patator.rationale: FTP-Patator is a password brute-force attack against FTP credentials.

Heartbleed.rationale: Heartbleed exploitation targets a vulnerable exposed service.

Infiltration.rationale: The CICIDS label is broad; mapped only as an initial placeholder for later contextual refinement.

PortScan.rationale: Port scanning aligns directly with network service discovery behavior.

SSH-Patator.rationale: SSH-Patator is a password brute-force attack against SSH credentials.

Web Attack - Brute Force.rationale: The label explicitly identifies brute-force web authentication behavior.

Web Attack - Sql Injection.rationale: SQL injection commonly exploits a public-facing web application, but exact ATT&CK mapping depends on deployment context.

Web Attack - XSS.rationale: XSS is an application attack pattern; ATT&CK mapping is context-dependent and should be refined during GraphRAG mapping.
